about: Exact-once text splices applied to copies of the oracle sources inside a git-archive export of the pin. Each 'old' must occur exactly once; the build refuses otherwise. Segment names are interpreted by scripts/phase1_mutation_go.py SEGMENTS.

e1.why: every pinned stage is one segment named after the stage, including a stage whose action panics
e1.old:
func (s *session) stage(name string, action func() error) bool {
	outcome, message := capture(action)
e1.new:
func (s *session) stage(name string, action func() error) bool {
	phase1CoverBegin(name)
	outcome, message := capture(action)
	phase1CoverEnd(s.id)

e1.why: the parse stage also renders its observations (SourceFile state, diagnostic accessors); only ParseSourceFile is production, the rest is the parse:observe segment
